summary: News pipeline whose embedding cron pays Workers AI for a batch before marking it done, with no attempt limit per article.

expected_findings.contains: const { data } = await env.AI.run(EMBED_MODEL, { text: results.map((r) => `${r.title}\n\n${r.body}`) });

also.contains: UPDATE articles SET embedded_at = ? WHERE id = ?

expected_findings.explanation: embedPending() runs every 5 minutes, selects the 50 oldest articles with embedded_at IS NULL, pays Workers AI to embed them, upserts them to Vectorize, and only then sets embedded_at. There is no attempt count per article. If the Vectorize upsert or the D1 batch keeps failing for one article (for example a partner source_id over the vector ID limit), the whole batch is never marked done, so every run re-embeds the same 50 articles with no user activity until someone notices. Once it starts, the cost rate is fixed: about 7.4M tokens of bge-base-en-v1.5 a day at its 512-token input limit, roughly 4.5x the included 10,000 Neurons a day, or about $11 a month: more than about $5 and far below about $100, so Medium.

must_not_flag.reason: A legacy key costs one KV read, whatever the number of legacy keys.
